svg.text: Supply and power circuit (multi-line, detached): rails at the top, each feeder drops down its own column
path (column) numbers in the frame band; dotted lines = column borders (not drawn on a real page)
outgoing potentials leave by interruption points
Order down a column: protection, switching, terminal, load
Tags left of the symbol (blue); terminal numbers beside the pins
Contactor coil is detached: its page/column under the tag (/4.2)
Rails 1 step apart in order L1 L2 L3 N PE; drops carry a dot
on their own rail and cross the rails below without a dot
Sketch on the page grid: 1 step = the connection grid (4 mm native). Drawing area ~100 x 64 steps (A3 landscape). Not to exact scale.
Pole pitch 2 steps, one feeder per column pair; PE drop at the right of each feeder; spare columns stay empty for later feeders.
